title: Miso-Butter Mushroom Pasta
description: A deeply savory pasta where white miso and butter melt into a silky sauce with seared mushrooms and garlic. Umami on umami, ready in the time it takes to boil water.

ingredients.name: mixed mushrooms
ingredients.notes: cremini and shiitake, sliced 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, greens and whites separated

steps.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package directions until just shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.

While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat until nearly smoking. Add mushrooms in a single layer — don't crowd, don't stir. Let them sear undisturbed until deeply golden on the bottom, about 4 minutes. Flip and cook another 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium. Add butter, garlic, and scallion whites. Cook, stirring, until garlic is fragrant and softened, about 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk miso paste with 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water until smooth. Pour into the skillet along with soy sauce. Stir to combine.

Add drained pasta directly to the skillet. Toss vigorously, adding more pasta water a splash at a time until the sauce coats every strand — glossy, not soupy. This takes about 2 minutes of active tossing.
Finish with a generous amount of cracked black pepper and the scallion greens.
